note: Direct public destinations for sportsbooks WizardOfOdds is NOT paid by. Deliberately a separate file from ops/wizardofodds_affiliates.json: nothing recorded here is an affiliate, nothing here carries a tracking parameter, and nothing here may be sent through the site's affiliate redirect. A book is in this file only so that a reader shown the best available price can actually reach it; the selection itself is made by the routing rule before this file is consulted, and a book's presence or absence here must never change which sportsbook is selected.
source: predictions/api/live_props.php, the NBA live-props page's own $AFFILIATE_CONFIG. That array declares one entry per book the site links. Three of its entries -- bovada, betonlineag and betus -- carry an affiliate tracking parameter and are therefore NOT reproduced here: those books are primary affiliates and are routed through the site's go.php redirect, per the site's own convention that an affiliate click never uses a direct URL. The entries below are the ones that carry no tracking parameter of any kind, which is what makes them direct links rather than referrals.
